hooks.command: STAGED=$(git diff --cached --name-only 2>/dev/null); if echo "$STAGED" | grep -q 'mt-skills/' && ! echo "$STAGED" | grep -q 'mt-skills/.mt-version'; then printf '{"continue":false,"stopReason":"\u26a0\ufe0f mt-skills/ has changes but .mt-version was not bumped. Update mt-skills/.mt-version before committing."}'; else printf '{"continue":true}'; fi
